summary: Retest after CORS config change in backend/server.py (CORS_ORIGINS allowlist + allow_origin_regex for emergentagent.com/emergent.host subdomains). Added 1 new backend test file (3 tests) verifying the regex preflight match, rejection of an unrelated origin, and the full authenticated flow (login/branding/projects/dashboard/reports.monthly) through the public preview URL. Re-ran all 7 prior backend test files (8 tests) and all 7 prior browser checks by name only. 19/19 artifacts passed. 3 browser checks (satis-role-restricted-buttons, monthly-report-page-renders, dealer-portal-shows-only-own-project) failed on the first back-to-back rerun with transient 429 rate-limit console errors identical to the pattern already documented in iteration_2; each passed cleanly on a solo rerun and is classified flaky, not a bug.
action_items: Noted (not a bug): a direct curl OPTIONS preflight against the PUBLIC https hostname (through the Cloudflare/ingress edge in front of the app) returned 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' even for the preview's own origin, while the identical preflight sent directly to the uvicorn backend (:8001) returned 200 with a correctly-echoed Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. This indicates an edge/CDN layer ahead of the FastAPI app enforces its own CORS policy independent of server.py, consistent with the briefing's spec_deviations note that the user's reported issue is tied to the live custom domain/edge and not reproducible/fixable from the app code in preview. All real browser flows (SPA same-origin requests, cookie-based login) through the public preview URL continued to work in every browser check, so no regression was introduced by the server.py change itself.
